description_en: Disassociates an access control list (ACL) from a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 调用DisassociateACL将智能接入网关实例跟访问控制解绑
kebab_example: aliyun smartag disassociate-acl --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id acl-xhwhyuo43l00000 --smart-ag-id sag-ke3kq4evpi80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisassociateACL

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the region where the ACL is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~69813~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
